title: Free Camping Site Properties
description: Schema for the 'properties' object of a GeoJSON Feature representing one dispersed camping site on public land.

id.description: Stable unique slug for the site (lowercase, hyphenated).

land_manager.description: Agency that manages the land (free string — e.g. a National Forest, state conservation agency, BLM field office). Use the agency's canonical name so filter checkboxes group correctly; existing values include "Mark Twain National Forest" and "Missouri Department of Conservation".

access.description: Road/vehicle access character for reaching the site.

last_verified.description: ISO 8601 date the entry was last reviewed against its source. This records when the entry was last looked at, not a guarantee that the location is confirmed accurate — see notes/source for uncertainty flags.

fire_restrictions.description: Fire rules for the site (e.g. established rings only, seasonal bans).

cell_signal.description: Typical cell signal at the site.

rig_size_limit_ft.description: Maximum recommended rig length in feet, or null if no practical limit / unknown.

photos.description: Photo references: relative paths under data/photos/ or absolute URLs.

source.description: Where this entry came from (agency page URL, forum thread, personal visit, etc.).

notes.description: Caveats, uncertainty flags, or other honest context about the entry.
